The strip of the exchanges that are open

Source: R/fct_markets.R
market_strip.Rd

A row of small labels, one per exchange, with a green dot when it is open, an amber one at lunch and a grey one when it is closed. Hovering over a label gives its local time, when that changes and its indices; the table of market_table() has them all.

Usage

market_strip(status, table_id = NULL)

Arguments

status

The result of market_status().

table_id

The id of that table on the page, for a link to it, or NULL for none.

Value

A div of Shiny UI elements.

Examples

golemstockindices:::market_strip(market_status())
#> <div class="market-strip">
